controller_view.note: This file is controller-side visibility only. It must not be interpreted as a live Spectre heartbeat.
controller_view.likely_root_cause: Factory is configured AUTO_START=AT_LOGON; if install/pairing occurred in the current logon session and installer did not start watcher immediately, watcher may not have started yet.
controller_view.next_physical_action: ONE Windows restart or sign-out/sign-in to trigger the registered AT_LOGON watcher. Then allow up to 2 minutes for first poll/result creation.

desired_v11_visibility.requirement: Spectre itself should expose a persistent visible status showing watcher alive, last poll, active job, last result, and next queued job.
desired_v11_visibility.preferred_surface: small always-available local status window or tray indicator; no Director debugging steps
desired_v11_visibility.install_behavior: Installer must start watcher immediately after successful install, in addition to registering AT_LOGON auto-start.
